pages.text: $(thing)Вогонь$() є важливим технологічним процесом. Щоб створити вогонь, тобі знадобиться $(thing)примітивне кресало$(). Щоб скористатись ним, просто тримай його у руці, та $(item)$(k:key.use)$() по землі. Через кілька секунд з’явиться дим, а потім спалахне вогонь. Може знадобитися кілька успішних спроб запалювання.
Crafting a firestarter can be done with two sticks. Firestarters can be used for any task that requires lighting, such as igniting a candle or starting a forge.

With a firestarter, you can light a $(thing)Firepit$(). To make one, you will need one $(thing)log$(), three $(thing)sticks$(), and optionally up to five pieces of $(thing)kindling$(). Kindling can be items such as paper products, straw, or fallen leaves, and will increase the chance of successfully creating a firepit by 10 percent per item used. Throw ($(item)$(k:key.drop)$()) all the items on the ground, on the same block. Then use the firestarter on the block with the items floating above it.
pages.title: Багаття

pages.name: Fire!
pages.text: Якщо тобі вдалося, буде створено багаття

Using the firepit will now open the firepit screen. On the left are four $(thing)fuel$() slots. Logs, Peat, and Stick Bundles can all be used as firepit fuel by placing them in the topmost slot. Fuel will be consumed from the bottommost slot. There is a gauge which displays the current $(thing)Temperature$() of the firepit, and on the right, a slot for items to be $(l:game_mechanics/heating)heated$() in.

Багато корисного можна виготовити у багатті. З однієї палички можна отримати два $(thing)смолоскипи$(). Зауважте, що смолоскипи згодом згорять, їх потрібно запалити знов за допомогою $(thing)кресала$(), або іншого  $(thing)смолоскипа$().

The fire pit is also a good device for $(l:cooking/cooking_methods)Cooking Food$(). All raw meats can be cooked in a firepit, which will lengthen their shelf life. More on decay and preservation can be read $(l:cooking/decay)here$().

The firepit can be extinguished at any time by using a $(thing)Shovel$() on it.$(br2)A firepit can also have other devices added to it to extend its functionality. Using a $(thing)Wrought Iron Grill$() will convert the firepit into a $(l:cooking/cooking_methods#grill)Grill$(), and using a $(thing)Ceramic Pot$() will convert the firepit into a $(l:cooking/cooking_methods#pot)Pot$(). To remove either device, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() while holding $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$(). Be careful not to try to remove a hot grill or pot!

Firepit fuels have different levels of purity. Fuel purity effects how long a fuel burns for and what temperature it may reach. The most pure fuels are logs, while fuels like straw and fallen leaves do not get hot enough to do much cooking, but can help you keep warm in a pinch.
